from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashMetric(BaseModel):
    """A specific cash or equivalent value reported in one company's filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company filing the report")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The date or period covered by the financial statement")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the cash line item as written in the document")
    reported_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the cash line item as reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the reported amount (e.g. 'dollars', 'thousands')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_metrics: list[CashMetric]
